mapper.select: SELECT id, NAME, sku_sn, pic_url, spec_ids, supply_price, purchase_price, retail_price, market_price, stock FROM pms_sku WHERE deleted = 0 and spu_id = #{id}

SELECT t1.id, t1.sku_sn, concat(t2.name, ' ', t1.name) skuName, ifnull(t1.pic_url, t2.pic_url) pic_url, t1.supply_price, t1.retail_price, t1.market_price marketPrice, t1.stock, t2.name as spuName, t2.spu_type spuType, t2.id spuId, t1.supplier_id supplierId, t3.supplier_name supplierName, t2.shop_id shopId, t4.shop_name shopName, t2.forbidden_area_id as forbiddenAreaId, t2.freight_template_id as freightTemplateId FROM pms_sku t1 INNER JOIN pms_spu t2 ON t1.spu_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN pms_supplier t3 ON t1.supplier_id = t3.id LEFT JOIN pms_shop t4 ON t2.shop_id = t4.id WHERE t1.id = #{id} and t2.status = 1

SELECT t1.id, t1.sku_sn as skuSn, concat(t2.name, ' ', t1.name) as skuName, IFNULL(t1.pic_url, t2.pic_url) as picUrl, t1.spec_ids as specIds, t1.supply_price as supplyPrice, t1.retail_price as retailPrice, t1.market_price as marketPrice, t1.stock, t1.locked_stock as lockedStock, t2.id as spuId, t2.spu_type, t2.name as spuName, t2.supplier_id as supplierId, t3.supplier_name as supplierName, t2.shop_id as shopId, t4.shop_name as shopName, t2.forbidden_area_id as forbiddenAreaId, t2.freight_template_id as freightTemplateId, t2.need_delivery FROM pms_sku t1 INNER JOIN pms_spu t2 ON t1.spu_id = t2.id LEFT JOIN pms_supplier t3 ON t1.supplier_id = t3.id LEFT JOIN pms_shop t4 ON t2.shop_id = t4.id WHERE t2.status = 1 and t1.id IN
#{id}
SELECT k.id FROM pms_sku k WHERE k.deleted = 0 AND (k.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR k.sku_sn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY k.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
